title: Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable

translated_title: 知识图谱上复杂查询回答的相似性约束重加权方法
translated_abstract: 知识图谱上的复杂查询回答（CQA）机器学习模型用于估计那些无法通过直接遍历得到的答案的可能性。最近的工作提出用软实体约束来扩展此类查询，这些约束要求目标变量与指定的实体集合相似或不相似。我们研究了一种更一般的形式，其中相似性约束可以指定在查询中的任意变量上，并提出了SCORE：一种计算高效且可解释的方法，用于在查询的任意变量上引入相似性约束。SCORE基于一个轻量且可解释的分数调整函数，只需在验证集上调节两个超参数。我们的实验表明，SCORE能够有效地融合偏好信息，同时保持强大的查询回答性能。当约束应用于目标变量时，它显著提升了排序质量。
tldr: 本文提出SCORE方法，通过轻量且可解释的分数调整函数，将相似性约束高效地应用于知识图谱复杂查询中的任意变量，仅需调节两个超参数即可在保持查询回答性能的同时显著提升排序质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCORE, a computationally efficient and interpretable method that incorporates similarity constraints on arbitrary variables in complex query answering over knowledge graphs, requiring only two tunable hyperparameters while maintaining strong query answering performance and significantly improving ranking quality.
